about_the_game:
Mira's Journal is a top-down RPG where you live each day, exploring, and fighting in a battle system based around Color!

Along the way you'll meet a cast of unique characters that you'll bond with on your journey.

The story

A young girl named Mira Levenor finds herself in a strange realm, surrounded on all sides by void.

Many have been trapped here for generations, who have long lost hope of one day getting out. Will Mira and the people she meets along the way finally be the ones with enough courage to break everyone out?

Get to know your party

Throughout the adventure, you'll gain allies of varying backgrounds, as well as abilities! Each day you have the chance to get to know them and spend time with them!

A Color based Battle System!

Fight your way through turn-based battles and exploit color based weaknesses! Each character and ability has a unique color that affects their enemies and allies according to each of their positions on the Color Wheel.

A calendar system, inspired by Persona

Shape Mira's daily life, and experience the story how you want to!

You can spend your time exploring dungeons, fulfilling requests and getting to know people, whether they'd be strangers or allies.

Fill the Journal with memories

Mira will keep track of her activities and personal thoughts each day on her Journal.

Explore her inner thoughts, rewind to something you missed, or just get to know her!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Fedora 32 or equivlent
  • Processor: Any x86_64 dual core CPU with support for SSE4.2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2 Support w/ 512MB of VRAM
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game runs in a 16:10 Aspect Ratio
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Fedora 40+ or equivlent
  • Processor: Any quad-core or higher x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: <8yr old Vulkan 1.2 Support w/ 2GB+ of VRAM
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game runs in a 16:10 Aspect Ratio

short_description: Trapped in a world surrounded by void, Mira unknowingly finds herself inside this lost realm. Comb this deteriorating land, fight enemies in Color-based battles, and form bonds with the inhabitants of what remains. Reveal what's forgotten and restore the people's hope.
